title: Dev F - tdd calculation doesnt work anymore
symptom: TDD calculation does not come up anymore; only 'calculation is being executed' message appears. It used to be slow but eventually worked. Resetting from statistics screen did not help. TDD calculation from Dana-I screen still works.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. User RalfCGM observed that TDD calculation works again after enabling loop, but maintainer MilosKozak states that TDD calculation is based only on data in DB and there is no relation to loop. Another user vanelsberg reports that updating to a specific commit fixed it, implying a possible bug in recent dev builds.
fix: User vanelsberg reports that updating to commit#4b6eab6a (8/1/2023) resolved the issue. User RalfCGM found that enabling loop temporarily makes TDD calculation work again, but this is not confirmed as a fix.
evidence_quote: After updating to commit#4b6eab6a (8/1/2023) it started working again.
